description_en: Queries the list of parsers, including basic parser information, running status, creation time, and modification time
description_zh: 调用该接口查询解析器列表信息，包括解析器基本信息、启动状态、创建时间和修改时间
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-parser --iot-instance-id iot-n8t0000 --page-size 10 --search-name DataParser --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListParser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A string contained in the parser name. The system performs a fuzzy match to retrieve parsers whose names contain this string
parameters.help_zh: 传入解析器名称中任意字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的解析器名称
parameters.name: search_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: current_page
